items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: The first week, we worked opposite

ctx.x: No... the Village something else. Because I remember right during that year, Ornette Coleman had moved back East and he was like a new... He was getting attention, really getting a lot of recognition. And he was working there the week before we came. We came in, Art Farmer was there. But that was like a hang-up. All the musicians came in.
I wish I could think of the name of this place. Anyway, we were there for two weeks. The first week, we worked opposite
of Dave Brubeck. The second week we worked opposite Stan Getz. The second week, on that weekend when Stan Getz was there, Gene Ammons was in town for 72 hours.
